title: Incredible west side hidden gems -PLEASE CONTACT BEFORE BOOKING
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Portuguese/English speaking. 
We are a small local customized private tour company. We value and understand your limited time while on vacation. We truly are excited to focus and concentrate on your fun and the enjoyment in Hawaii. We are so proud to share the knowledge of our culture and lifestyle. You'll glance at the highlighted beauty of this paradise inside and out. We'll be concentrating on hidden areas that you might not want to miss. So..let's take a journey of exciting adventure with us while exploring this island.
Call us and we can discuss what you expect on a tour. Every tour with us has flexibility with time and itinerary. Some of you will be up early due to the time zone you came from, you can start a tour as early as 5am. For those who have flights departing in the evenings and need to check out at 11am, we can incorporate a tour and airport dropped off . Make the most of your time and save airport transfers fees. Don’t miss the opportunity of your lifetime with us.
